about: Production npm advisories accepted after a reachability review. check-npm-audit.cjs fails on any advisory not listed here. Re-review by the date given; remove entries when the dependency is upgraded. See docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.

GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf.reason: Only anchor/dist/*/workspace.js parses TOML (the local Anchor.toml when anchor.workspace is accessed). Neither the testbench nor the keeper accesses anchor.workspace or parses untrusted TOML. No @coral-xyz/anchor 0.3x release drops toml.

GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j.reason: Same as GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf: unreachable, no untrusted TOML is parsed.

GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x.reason: web3.js imports only jayson/lib/client/browser, which requires uuid and generateRequest. stream-json is used only by jayson's server-side utils.parseStream. The fix needs jayson 5, outside web3.js 1.x's ^4.3.0 range.

GHSA-hqr4-qq8f-hg3x.reason: Same as GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: not on any code path we load.

GHSA-mjw6-4jj6-33hc.reason: Same as GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: not on any code path we load.

GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq.reason: The bug needs v3/v5/v6 called with a caller-supplied buffer. jayson's browser client calls uuid.v4() with no arguments.
